config.label: Toolsets to load at startup: 'all', 'none', or a comma-separated list
config.description: Toolsets to load at startup: 'all', 'none', or a comma-separated list. Default: core,metadata. All 228 tools stay available via sf_find_tool / sf_load_toolset, and callable via sf_call_tool even on clients that do not refresh their tool list.
